description: Reset the target user's password without knowing the current one.

telemetry.detail: An attempt was made to reset an account's password - default-on, high fidelity for privileged targets.
User account changed (pwdLastSet) - accompanies the reset.
Resetting a privileged account's password is disruptive (the real user is locked out) and commonly alerted; noisier than shadow creds.

abuse_primitive: Reset target password, authenticate as target.
notes: 4724 is on by default. Louder than AddKeyCredentialLink because it changes state the legitimate user will notice. Prefer shadow creds where the target object supports it.
